n-k-k10-04.thinking.0: Soo koobid aan wax ka dhigin
n-k-k10-04.title: Hal ogeysiis, laba deriska ah
n-k-k10-04.topic: Soo koobidda ogeysiis rasmi ah iyadoo aan lumin xadadkiisa
n-k-k10-04.goal: Hel sadarka soo koobidda ee beddelaya xadka waqtiga ogeysiiska, kadibna dib u qor ogeysiiska koox sheekaysi deriska iyo xusuusin hadal ah oo loogu talagalay deris da' weyn, adigoo ilaalinaya taariikhda, saacadaha iyo dhismaha si sax ah.
n-k-k10-04.material:
Xafiiska maamulku wuxuu dhejiyay ogeysiis. Waxaad ku nooshahay 101동.

[단수 안내]
배관 점검 공사로 10월 25일 토요일 오전 9시부터 오후 2시까지 101동 전 세대의 물이 나오지 않습니다. 공사가 일찍 끝나면 물이 먼저 나올 수 있습니다. 단수 전에 필요한 물을 미리 받아 두시기 바라며, 공사 후 처음 나오는 물은 누런색일 수 있으니 잠시 틀어 둔 뒤 사용하시기 바랍니다.
n-k-k10-04.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan 합쇼체, 해요체 iyo -(으)세요 ee ixtiraamka
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.prompt: Deris ayaa samaystay afar soo koobid oo gaagaaban oo ogeysiiska ah. Kee ayaa beddela macnaha?
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.0: Dib u akhri ogeysiiska oo ku taxay xaqiiqooyinkiisa (goorma, xaggee, maxaa la sameeyo). Kadib soo koobid kasta la barbar dhig liiskaaga.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.1: Raadi weedho kasta oo waqtiga ka dhigaya mid ka dheer, ka gaaban, ama ka dabacsan waxa ogeysiisku sheego.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.a: Tani waxay ilaalisaa taariikhda, saacadaha iyo dhismaha si sax ah sida ogeysiisku u leeyahay.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.b: Ogeysiisku wuxuu leeyahay biyuhu way ka hore soo noqon karaan haddii shaqadu goor hore dhammaato.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.c: Ogeysiisku wuxuu leeyahay biyaha ugu horreeya kadib shaqada waxay noqon karaan kuwo huruud ah oo waa in xoogaa la daayo.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.explain: '하루 종일' waxay qaadaysaa gooyn shan-saacadood ah (9:00-14:00) oo ka dhigaysa maalin buuxda, taasoo dadka ka dhigi lahayd inay qorshe khaldan sameeyaan.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.prompt: Qor fariin gaaban (2-3 weedhood) oo loogu talagalay kooxda sheekaysiga deriska ee Kuuriyaan, 해요체 saaxiibtinimo leh. Ilaali taariikhda, saacadaha, dhismaha iyo talada biyaha si sax ah.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ku taxay afarta xaqiiqo ee ay tahay inay badbaadaan: goorma, ilaa goorma, yaa ay saameynayso, maxaa marka hore la sameeyo.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.hint.1: Mid kasta ku dhig 해요체 saaxiibtinimo leh oo ku beddel weedhaha adag ee ogeysiiska erayo sheekaysi.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma derisku ee fariintayda keliya akhriya wuu ogaan lahaa si sax ah goorma iyo xaggee biyuhu go'aan?
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma u egtahay sheekaysi deris ah halkii ay ahaan lahayd ogeysiis?
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.prompt: Waxaad kula kulantay deris da' weyn wiishka. Dheh qodobka ugu muhiimsan hal ama laba weedhood oo hadal ah oo Kuuriyaan ah, si ixtiraam leh (ixtiraam). Ilaali maalinta, saacadaha iyo talada.
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore deriska ku salaan si ixtiraam leh (어르신, 할머니, 할아버지 ...).
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.hint.1: Isticmaal -(으)세요 ama -(으)시- waxa deriska sameeyo, oo saacadaha ka dhig kuwo gaagaaban.
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sidan baan u hadli lahaa qof da' weyn oo aan ixtiraamo?
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma derisku ka fal-celin karaa (maalinta, saacadaha, diyaarinta biyaha) tan oo keliya?

n-k-k10-01.title: Yaa yidhi, intee adag?
n-k-k10-01.topic: Hadalka la soo sheegay: qoritaanka iyo xooggan sheegashada
n-k-k10-01.goal: Is barbar dhig soo koobidda arday iyo diiwaanka asalka ah ee dhegaysiga, hel sadarrada si khaldan u soo sheegay hadle, magacaaw nooca isbeddelka, oo dib u qor hal sadar adigoon qalloocin.
n-k-k10-01.material:
Arday wargeys dugsi ayaa soo koobay kulan dadweyne. Hoose waa erayada saxda ah ee hadlayaasha kadibna soo koobidda ardayga.

[간담회 발언 기록] 주제: 전통시장 주차장 유료화
박 시장: "내년 3월부터 시범 운영을 검토하고 있습니다. 아직 확정된 것은 아닙니다."
김 상인회장: "유료화되면 손님이 줄어들까 걱정입니다. 첫 30분은 무료로 해 주셨으면 합니다."
이 교수: "다른 도시에서는 유료화 후 주차 회전율이 높아졌다는 연구가 있습니다. 다만 상인 매출에 미친 영향은 도시마다 달랐습니다."
n-k-k10-01.thinking.2: Dib u qorista warbixin si ay u aamin ahaato
n-k-k10-01.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan hadalka la soo sheegay (-다고 했다) iyo -(으)ㄹ까 걱정이다
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.prompt: Laba sadar oo soo koobidda ardayga ah kuma habboona waxa hadlaha la magacaabay yidhi. Dooro mid ka mid ah (mid kasta wuu tirsanayaa).
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sadar kasta isu soo qaad oo ka hel qofka uu magacaabayo diiwaanka.
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.1: Is barbar dhig sheegashada sadarka iyo weedhaha qofkaas: ma isla sheegasho, ma isla qof ayaa yidhi?
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.2: Haddii sadar u muuqdo mid waafaqsan, dhig ag weedha diiwaanka ee ka yimid oo is barbar dhig erayo erayo.
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 2 wuxuu u beddelayaa walaaca hoggaamiyaha ganacsatada ('줄어들까 걱정입니다') saadaal toosan ('단언했다'). Sadarka 5 wuxuu siiyaa faallada borofisarka ee cilmi-baarista duqa magaalada. Sadarrada 1, 3, 4 iyo 6 waxay waafaqsan yihiin diiwaanka.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.prompt: Laba sadar ayaa khaldan. Kuwee LABA sharaxaad ayaa ku habboon waxa ku khaldamay?
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sharax dhibaatada sadar kasta oo khaldan hal weedh ka hor intaadan eegin doorashooyinka.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.1: Doorasho kasta go'aami in ay ka dhacdo sadar aad dooratay ama midna.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.o.a: Faallo ayaa loo nisbeeyey hadle khaldan.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.b: Labada sadar ee khaldan labaduba waxay ilaaliyaan tirooyinka (3월, 30분) sida ay ahaayeen; qalloocinta meel kale ayay ka jirtaa.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.o.c: Walaac ayaa loo sheegay saadaal adag.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.d: Codsiga 30 daqiiqo oo bilaash ah waxaa loo sheegay codsi ('요청했다') sadarka 3, taasoo sax ah.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.explain: Hal sadar wuxuu u nisbeeyaa faallada cilmi-baarista borofisarka duqa magaalada; midka kale wuxuu kor u qaadaa '걱정입니다' natiijo hubaal ah.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.prompt: Dib u qor sadarka khaldan ee ku saabsan 상인회장 si uu u sheego erayadiisa adigoon qalloocin. Qor Kuuriyaan (nooca wararka, tusaale -다고 말했다) ama Ingiriis.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ku bilow weedha qofka diiwaanku magacaabay, kadibna sheeg waxa qofkaas dareemay ama weydiistay.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.1: Dooro fal ama dhammaad ku habboon 'I am worried that...' halkii 'it will happen'.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma falkayga ama dhammaadkayga wuxuu muujiyaa walaac halkii hubaal?
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma 상인회장 akhrin karaa weedhayga oo dhihi karaa 'haa, taasi waa wixii aan idhi'?
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wuxuu isticmaalaa qaab suurtagalnimo halkii 걱정.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.2: Madaxa ururka ganacsatada wuxuu yidhi wuu walaacsan yahay inay macaamiil yar yimaadaan.

n-k-k10-02.title: Waqtiyada layliga kuwee ayaa ka badbaada qaanuun kasta?
n-k-k10-02.topic: Ogeysiis leh qayb ka reeban: helitaanka dhammaan doorashooyinka sax ah
n-k-k10-02.goal: Akhri ogeysiis qol xaruun leh qaanuun wakhtiga kama danbeysta, nasashada qadada, xidhitaanka usbuuca dhammaadkiisa iyo ka reebid xilliga imtixaanka, hel saddex waqti layli oo taariikho kala duwan ah oo raacaya qaanuun kasta, oo codso mid Kuuriyaan ahaan.
n-k-k10-02.material:
Maanta waa 10월 10일, 월요일. Kooxdaada muusigga ayaa rabta inay qolka xaruunta ka dalbato maanta.

[동아리방 사용 안내]
1. 사용 신청은 사용일 3일 전까지 받습니다.
2. 사용 시간은 오전 10시부터 오후 8시까지이며, 한 팀이 한 번에 쓸 수 있는 시간은 3시간 이내입니다.
3. 낮 12시부터 오후 1시까지는 점심시간이므로 사용할 수 없습니다.
4. 토요일과 일요일에는 문을 열지 않습니다.
5. 단, 시험 기간인 10월 17일부터 19일까지는 사용할 수 없습니다.

밴드 친구의 문자: "우리 공연이 22일이라 21일까지는 연습을 끝내야 해요. 연습은 한 번에 2시간 이상 해야 하고요."
n-k-k10-02.thinking.0: Isku dhafidda dhawr shuruudood isku mar
n-k-k10-02.thinking.1: Helitaanka ka reeban oo loo qoray 단
n-k-k10-02.thinking.2: Helitaanka in ka badan hal jawaab oo sax ah
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.prompt: Shuruudda 1 waxay tidhi codsiyadu waxay xidhmaan saddex maalmood ka hor maalinta isticmaalka. Haddii aad codsato maanta (10-ka), taariikhaha isticmaalka maxay oggolaadaan?
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.0: Weydii: taariikhda isticmaalka kee ayay 'maanta' tahay saddex maalmood ka hor?
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii taariikh dambe ka dhigayso codsiga mid hore ama dambe marka loo eego wakhtiga kama danbeysta.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.o.a: 13-ka ama taariikh kasta oo ka dambeysa
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.b: Taasi waxay rogaysaa jihada: qaanuunku wuxuu dejiyaa maalinta ugu horreysa ee aad dalban karto, ma aha tan ugu dambeysa.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.c: '-까지' wuxuu bixiyaa xad, ma aha hal maalin oo sax ah; taariikho dambe sidoo kale waa la oggol yahay.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.o.d: 7-da ama taariikh kasta oo ka dambeysa
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.d: Tani waxay tirisaa saddex maalmood dib laga bilaabo maanta, laakiin qaanuunku wuxuu ka tiriyaa maalinta isticmaalka.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.explain: Codsashada 10-ka waa saddex maalmood ka hor 13-ka, sidaas darteed 13-ka waa taariikhda isticmaalka ugu horreysa taariikho dambena sidoo kale way shaqeeyaan.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.prompt: Hel 3 waqti layli 3 taariikho kala duwan oo buuxiya ogeysiiska iyo fariinta saaxiibka kooxda. d = taariikhda Oktoobar, s = saacadda bilowga saacad 24-saac ah (오후 2시 = 14), t = saacadaha layliga.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qor jadwalka laga bilaabo 10-ka: taariikh kasta maalintee ayay tahay? 10-ku waa Isniin.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore ka tir taariikhaha (aad u dhow, aad u dambeeya, usbuuca dhammaadkiisa, ka reeban), kadibna dooro saacadaha.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.2: Saacadda ugu dambeysa hubi: ka bilow 10 ama ka dambeeya, ku dhammee 20, ilaali 12-13 bannaan, oo ka dhig 2-3 saacadood.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c0: Isticmaal maalmo dhan iyo saacado dhan.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.ok.c1: La buuxiyey ugu yaraan 3 maalmood ka hor.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Aad ayuu u dhow yahay: wakhtiga kama danbeysta codsigu waa 3 maalmood ka hor maalinta isticmaalka.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Qolka xaruuntu wuu xidhan yahay maalintaas (usbuuca dhammaadkiisa).
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Taariikhdaasi waxay ku jirtaa xilliga imtixaanka.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c5: Waqtigu wuu bilaabmaa aad u hore ama wuu dhammaadaa ka dib xidhitaanka.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c6: Layligu waa inuu ahaadaa ugu yaraan 2 saacadood, xaruuntuna waxay oggolaataa ugu badnaan 3.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c7: Waqtigu wuxuu ku dhacayaa nasashada qadada 12:00-13:00.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.explain: Afar taariikh oo keliya ayaa shaqeeya: 13-ka iyo 14-ka (Kham, Jim) iyo 20-ka iyo 21-ka (Kham, Jim). 15-ka-16-ka waa usbuuca dhammaadkiisa, 17-ka-19-ka waa xilliga imtixaanka (ka reebanaanta), 12-ka aad ayuu u dhow yahay, 22-kana aad ayuu u dambeeyaa. Taariikh kasta saacaduhu waa inay iska ilaaliyaan qadada oo ku jiraan 10:00-20:00.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Dooro HAL waqti oo aad dhisatay oo qor fariin gaaban oo Kuuriyaan ah (edeb leh) oo loo diro maamulaha qolka xaruunta oo codsanaysa. Sheeg taariikhda iyo waqtiga.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ku bilow salaan ama taariikhda, kadibna muddada waqtiga.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ku dhammee codsi edeb leh sida -고 싶습니다 ama 신청합니다.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma taariikhda iyo waqtiyadu waxay la jaanqaadayaan waqti aan dhisay?
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma fariintu waa edeb ku filan maamule?

n-k-k10-03.title: Ma dukaanku diidi karaa lacag celintan?
n-k-k10-03.topic: Qaanuunno leh ka reeban: xaqiiqadee ayaa go'aamisa kiiska
n-k-k10-03.goal: Hel xaqiiqada keliya ee maqan ee go'aamisa codsi lacag celin qaanuun ka reeban leh hoostiisa, sheeg waxa durba la sheegi karo, oo si edeb leh ugu weydii xaqiiqada maqan Kuuriyaan ahaan.
n-k-k10-03.material:
Qaanuunnada lacag celinta dukaan iyo codsi macmiil.

[환불 안내]
1. 구매일로부터 7일 이내에 신청하시면 환불해 드립니다.
2. 포장을 뜯었거나 사용한 상품은 환불이 되지 않습니다.
3. 단, 상품에 불량이 있는 경우에는 구매일로부터 30일 이내에 포장이나 사용 여부와 상관없이 환불해 드립니다.

[주문 내역] 무선 이어폰 1개 / 구매일: 10월 3일
오늘은 10월 12일입니다. 손님: "이어폰이 생각보다 별로예요. 환불해 주세요."
n-k-k10-03.thinking.2: Jawaabidda inta xaqiiqooyinku oggol yihiin oo keliya
n-k-k10-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 단 (ka reeban) iyo -(으)ㄴ 경우
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.prompt: Adigu waxaad tahay karraanigu. Xaqiiqadee MAQAN keliya ayaa beddeli lahayd in lacag celin la samayn karo?
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore xisaabi imisa maalmood ayaa ka soo wareegay iibsashada oo is barbar dhig qaanuunka koowaad.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kadibna hel qaanuunka weli caawin kara macmiilka oo eeg waxa uu u baahan yahay.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.a: Inuu macmiilku bixiyey kaarka ama lacag caddaan ah.
n-k-k10-03.thinking.1: Ma u qaadanin xaqiiqooyin aan la bixin
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.a: Xeerarku waxba kama sheegaan sida macmiilku u bixiyay lacagta.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.b: Haddii dhegaha-qalabka weli ku xidhan yihiin baakadkooda.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.b: Xadka 7-ta maalmood hore ayuu u dhacay, sidaa darteed baakad xidhan oo keliya lacag celin kuma mudna, xeerka 3 na baakadka ma tixgeliyo.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.d: Diiwaanka dalabku horeyba wuxuu muujinayaa taariikhda iibsiga, xeerarkuna rasiid ma weydiistaan.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.explain: Laga tirinayo 10월 3일, maanta waa maalinta 9aad, sidaa darteed xeerka 1 mar dambe ma khuseeyo. Xeerka 3 oo keliya ayaa weli bixin kara lacag celin, wuxuuna ku xidhan yahay haddii cillad jirto.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.prompt: Iyadoo lagu salaynayo waxa hadda la ogyahay oo keliya, maxaa karraaniga saxda ah ku odhan karaa?
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kala saar waxa xaqiiqooyinku horeyba go'aamiyeen iyo waxa ay furan yihiin.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Doorasho kasta hubi haddii ay ku darto xaqiiqo kiiska aan lagu sheegin, ama ay ka tagto xeer.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.a: Lacag celin waa suurtagal, sababtoo ah codsigu waa 7 maalmood gudahood.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.a: 10월 3일 ilaa 10월 12일 waa 9 maalmood, taasoo ka sii badan xadka 7-ta maalmood.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.b: Lacag celin sababtoo ah is-beddelka maskaxda way ka dhaaftay xadka, laakiin badeecad cillad leh weli way ku habboon tahay.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.c: Lacag celin lama heli karo xaalad kasta, sababtoo ah 7 maalmood ayaa dhaafay.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.c: Tani waxay iska indho tirtaa xeerka 3, kaas oo siiya 30 maalmood marka cillad jirto.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.d: Lacag celin waa suurtagal oo keliya haddii baakadku weli furmin.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.d: Baakadka aan la furin wuxuu muhiim yahay 7-ta maalmood gudahood oo keliya; kadib, xeerarka waxba kuma jiraan oo lacag celin ka bixiya badeecad aan la furin.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.e: Lacag celin lama heli karo, sababtoo ah baakadka waxay u badan tahay in la furay.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.e: Kiiska waxba kuma jiraan oo sheegaya in baakadka la furay; tani waa male-awaal.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.explain: Karraaniga wuxuu sheegi karaa waxa xaqiiqooyinka ka soo baxa: lacag celin lama bixiyo haddii badeecadda si fudud loo necbaaday kadib 7 maalmood, laakiin jawaabtu way isbeddeli kartaa haddii badeecaddu cillad leedahay.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.prompt: U jawaab macmiilka Kuuriyaan (edeb leh). Dheh xadka 7-ta maalmood wuu dhaafay lacag celinta is-beddelka maskaxda, kadibna weydii hal shay oo aad weli u baahan tahay inaad ogaato kahor intaadan go'aansan.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore sii sababta xeerka koowaad, si kooban oo edeb leh.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kadib dib u akhri saddexda xeer oo weydii xaqiiqada kiiska weli ka maqan.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxay sababta jawaabtu weli haa u ahayn?
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma su'aashaydu waxay weydiisaa hal xaqiiqo oo kiiska go'aamisa?

n-k-k10-05.title: 'Haa' ee macnaheedu ahaa maya
n-k-k10-05.topic: Ka jawaabidda su'aal diidmo ah: 네 iyo 아니요
n-k-k10-05.goal: Dib u eeg akhrintaada 네 keligiis ah kadib su'aal diidmo ah marka wada-hadalku muujiyo is-fahmi la'aan, dooro hab cad oo aad ku jawaabto, oo ku saxo is-fahmi la'aanta Kuuriyaan.
n-k-k10-05.material: Waxaad ka shaqeysaa shirkad. Madaxa waaxdaada (부장님) ayaa kaa weydiinaya kulanka berri. Labadiinuba si edeb leh ayaad u hadlaysaan.
n-k-k10-05.thinking.0: Ogaanshaha in jawaab gaaban loo akhrin karo laba siyaabood
n-k-k10-05.thinking.1: Dib u eegista akhris marka fal-celinta qofka kale muuqato
n-k-k10-05.thinking.2: Saxidda is-fahmi la'aan si edeb leh
n-k-k10-05.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan 네/아니요 iyo 안 + fal
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.prompt: Akhri qayb kasta oo dooro akhrinta u muuqata mid ugu suurtagalsan kahor intaadan sii wadin.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.hint.0: Go'aamin adigoo isticmaalaya sadarrada aad hadda ka hor akhriday oo keliya.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir waxa hadluhu laga yaabo inuu ku raacay: su'aasha sida loo weydiiyay, mise xaqiiqooyinka?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Maxay u badan tahay inuu 나 ula jeeday?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuuriyaanka caadiga ah 네 keligiis wuxuu ku raacayaa su'aasha sida loo weydiiyay ('네, 안 가요'), sidaa darteed a waa akhrinta caadiga ah. Akhrinta b waa sida hadle u adeegsada 'yes' Ingiriisi u ula jeedi karo. Si kasta ha ahaadee, 네 keligiis ma sheego dhegeystaha midka.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: 네 keligiis ah wuxuu muujin la'yahay shaki; jawaab aan la go'aansan waxay isticmaali lahayd erayo sida '글쎄요' ama '아직요'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: 네 caadi ahi waxba ma weydiiyo; codku waa inuu kor u kaco su'aashuna waa inay isticmaasho erayo.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Maxay u badan tahay inay dhacday?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Labadaba a iyo d way ku habboon yihiin, laakiin 나's 아니요 degdegga ah iyo xoojintu waxay ka sii tilmaamaan a: 네 keligiis ah waxaa loo maqlay 'ma aadayo' inkasta oo 나 ula jeeday 'haa, waan aadayaa'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 부장님 wuxuu 네 u maqlay 'ma aadayo'; 나 wuxuu ula jeeday 'haa, waan aadayaa'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 부장님 wuxuu 네 u maqlay 'wuu aadayaa', 나 na runtii ma aadayo.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Sadarka ugu dambeeya ee 나 wuxuu leeyahay 가요 iyo 갈 거예요, sidaa darteed 나 wuu aadayaa.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: 부장님 iyo 나 waxay isku khilaafsan yihiin taariikhda kulanka.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Midna ma sheego taariikh ama waqti.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: 나 wuxuu beddelay maskaxdiisa kadib marka 부장님 uu soo jeediyay inuu isaga u hadlo.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mar dambe marka su'aal diidmo ah timaado, hab jawaab kee ayaa ka fogaanaya dhibaatadan?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Ku celinta falka iyo diidmadiisa ama oggolaanshihiisa waxay xaqiiqada si toos ah u sheegtaa, sidaa darteed dhegeystuhu uma baahna inuu go'aamiyo waxa 네 loola jeedo.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ku jawaab 네 oo sharax kadib oo keliya haddii dhegeystuhu ku mashquulo.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Is-fahmi la'aantu horeyba waxay ka bilaabmaysaa 네 kowaad; sharaxaad dambe waxay saxdaa halkii ay ka hortagi lahayd.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ku jawaab 네 sare oo cad.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Codka sarreeya ma beddelo xaqiiqada ah in 네 loo maqli karo inuu ku raacayo su'aasha ama xaqiiqooyinka.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Had iyo jeer ku jawaab 아니요, su'aal kasta ha ahaato.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Had iyo jeer oo la yiraahdo 아니요 waxay bixin lahayd jawaab khaldan mar kasta oo jawaabta runta ah tahay inaadan aadayn.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Dheh 네 ama 아니요 oo ku celi falka: '네, 안 가요' ama '아니요, 가요'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.reflect: 네 ama 아니요 keligiis ah kadib su'aal diidmo ah ('안 가세요?') wuxuu ku xidhmaa su'aasha oo dhan, ma aha xaqiiqooyinka oo keliya, sidaa darteed waxaa loo maqli karaa laba siyaabood oo isdiidan. Ku darista falka ('아니요, 가요') ayaa ka hortagta is-fahmi la'aanta.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.prompt: Isla markiiba kadib is-fahmi la'aanta, waxaad u dirtaa 부장님 fariin gaaban oo Kuuriyaan ah (edeb leh) oo leh waxaad ula jeedday inaad AAD, oo aad ka raalli gelinayso jahwareerka.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.hint.0: La hadal 부장님 oo ku dheh raali-galin weedh gaaban oo ku saabsan jahwareerka.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.hint.1: Xaqiiqada ku sheeg falka (waxa aad berri samaynayso), ma aha erayga jawaabta keligiis.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma fariintaydu si cad bay u sheegaysaa inaan aadayo?
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma xaqiiqada ku sheegay falka halkii aad ka isticmaali lahayd 네 keligiis?
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma raali-galintaydu waa edeb iyadoon aad u dheerayn?
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.3: Ma 부장님 ku salaantay si ixtiraam leh?
